info.name: KairoX · Drawer (WITHDRAWN)
info.description:
THE DRAWER MODULE IS DELETED. `/api/v1/drawers/*` is gone — not renamed, not deprecated.

WHY. There were 200 physical drawers. A style releases 100+ garments, the run stalls mid-chain, and the next 50 have nowhere to go; re-allocating by hand was too complicated for the DM to actually do. The drawer was a bottleneck that earned nothing.

WHAT REPLACED IT. The store is now a STATE ON THE GARMENT, so it has no capacity and nothing runs out. Use `store.postman_collection.json`:
    POST /drawers/store-scan   ->  POST /store/scan   (one scan fewer)
    POST /drawers/send         ->  POST /store/send
    GET  /drawers/by-code/{c}  ->  GET  /store/pieces/{piece_code}
    GET  /drawers              ->  GET  /store/pieces
    GET  /drawers/pool         ->  (nothing — there is no pool)

The two requests below replace the drawer detail/movement screens. They are keyed by the GARMENT, which is what an operator can scan. read FROZEN history for audit; they are not live state.

SETUP
  1. Import the whole folder and SELECT the KairoX environment
     (top-right). That is what shares one token across every
     collection — a collection variable is visible only to the
     collection that set it.
  2. Run `user` → Login. Its test script stores `access_token` for
     you; there is nothing to copy and paste.
  3. Every request here inherits bearer auth from that token.

`base_url` defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000.

Optional query params are present but DISABLED, so each request runs
as-is. File uploads are real form-data rows — click Select Files on
the `file` row. Generated from the app's own OpenAPI schema by
`python scripts/make_postman_per_service.py` — re-run it after changing
routes rather than editing requests by hand.
